firecrawl_api_url.title: Firecrawl API URL
firecrawl_api_url.description: Firecrawl endpoint for web research. Cloud: https://api.firecrawl.dev. Self-hosted: for example http://localhost:3002.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Needed for Firecrawl cloud. Leave empty for a self-hosted instance. Without Firecrawl, research falls back to WebSearch and WebFetch.
